FFmpeg prebuilt package

Version:                 9.1
Source:                  https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.1.tar.xz
License:                 LGPL-2.1-or-later (built without --enable-gpl/--enable-nonfree)
Android:                 NDK 30.0.16248370, API 21, arm64-v8a + armeabi-v7a
                         one libffmpeg.so per ABI, built without NEON assembly
Windows x64:             MSYS2/MinGW-w64 gcc 16.2, shared DLLs + import libraries
Linux x86_64:            GCC 14.2, shared libav*/libsw* libraries (CI artifact)
AV1:                     libdav1d on Windows and Linux; the Android build uses the platform
                         AV1 decoder because FFmpeg 9's native AV1 decoder is hardware-only
Build scripts and flags: https://github.com/CoralFrameworks/FfmpegBuilder
